subject: dsa
title: Move Zeroes
summary: Keep a write pointer for the next non-zero slot. Scan with a read pointer; every non-zero you find gets swapped forward, so the zeros fall to the back.
problem: Move all 0s to the end while keeping the non-zero numbers in their original order — in place.

steps.caption: Push every 0 to the end, but keep the other numbers in their original order — and do it in place.
w marks where the next non-zero should land; r scans the array. r is on a 0 — skip it, advance r.
r finds 1 — a non-zero. Swap nums[r] into w's slot.
1 is now in place; w moves to 1. r advances and sits on a 0 — skip it.
r finds 3 — a non-zero. Swap it into w's slot.
3 placed; w is at 2. r finds 12 — also non-zero, so swap it too.
12 placed. r reached the end. The non-zeros kept their order; the 0s settled at the back.
